contract.identity: connector + tenant + collector source + verified bundle SHA256 + dataset + trade date; content-identical collector reruns share the record, corrected bundles retain distinct hashes.
contract.normalized_rows: Every verified row is written before provenance; per-symbol daily and intraday snapshot projection consumes original rows before aggregation.
contract.partial_delivery: Stable identities and PostgreSQL UPSERT across capped prefixes. Row count and rows hash recomputed from normalized partitions, selecting connector/tenant/bundle hash. Only one directory locator per dataset/date, no growing symbol or partition-file list.
contract.pit: Aggregate event/availability min/max, validated scalar PIT, trade date, content hash, normalized selector, original licence/ACL/attribution preserved.
contract.replay: Completed receipt and normalized partition identity (tenant, item id, full content hash, dataset, event and availability times) authorizes reuse without requiring per-row evidence.
contract.search: Bundle knowledge objects remain readable provenance; numeric bundles do not enter the semantic embedding pipeline. Existing text and legacy market knowledge remain eligible.
contract.distillation: No automatic admission or catch-up admission for numeric bundle summaries; explicit old/manual jobs are skipped before seed/evidence synthesis. Legacy market jobs retain existing behavior.
contract.compatibility: No deletion, schema migration or canonical record type change; additional metadata only. Original collector: source-id namespace retained.
contract.row_lineage_read: Existing source-record/{id} endpoint resolves a missing Collector row through completed normalized partitions selected by tenant-owned bundle refs; no per-row evidence is inserted. Foreign tenant 404 and unavailable owned partition 503 are tested.
contract.receipt_compatibility: The scalar evidence_bundle_id remains; additive evidence_bundle_ids lists every bundle/date group in a multi-date delivery. Native empty replay and completed-receipt storage reuse are tested.
contract.close_dedupe_compatibility: Verified close bundle summaries keep the existing collector-close:<source_id> dedupe namespace; their bundle source IDs still include the complete bundle identity. Historical non-close bundle summaries use collector-bundle:<source_id>. The existing close dedupe assertion remains unchanged.

scale.harness_boundary: Local PostgreSQL and real controller, API, pipeline, partitions, queue and snapshot writer. Test uses <=1000-row historical batches and daily cadence; separate default-cadence newest-session and held-symbol tests preserve current behavior. Lossless latest-envelope snapshot journal compaction between scale ticks preserves every retained point/checksum; this is test-only and not a production repair. The final scale run uses the supported two-close projection window; default 60-close/held/intraday behavior is verified separately, and all normalized history remains persisted. Desired-state scale fixture selects the three original market requirements only; unrelated paper/social sources are not scheduled.
